event_records.description: The quarter begins. Amara and her coworkers are at work.

amara.name: Amara
amara.persona_brief:
You are Amara.
Amara wants to be respected by her coworkers. She is aware of her own performance and interactions but uncertain how others perceive her.

coworkers_collective.name: Coworkers (collective)
coworkers_collective.persona_brief:
You are Coworkers (collective).
Each coworker has their own impressions of Amara based on past interactions. They may change their respect level based on future events.

resolution.question: Will Amara's coworkers respect her more by the end of the quarter?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the cutoff, there is observable evidence (e.g., coworkers explicitly state increased respect, seek her advice more frequently, or defer to her decisions) that indicates a net increase in respect from the start. Otherwise resolve NO.
